public_body: Arlington Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by letting Town Counsel respond to a complaint without first meeting to review it, rejected the Board's request to decline review, and resolved the matter by informal action.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to meet to review a December 23, 2024 Open Meeting Law complaint before Town Counsel sent a response on its behalf.
allegations.key_passage: By failing to meet to review the December 23 Complaint before a response was sent on its behalf, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Meet to review the December 23 Complaint within 25 days of the date of the letter, if it has not already.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order that the Board meet to review the December 23 Complaint within 25 days of the date of this letter, if it has not already. We also order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
